name: plesk-deploy
description: Set up and run safe, approval-gated deployments to Plesk servers: the plesk-deploy workflow as a skill, plus the plesk-deploy-mcp server that inspects the project, generates and validates the deploy kit, and (opt-in) reads status and logs and rolls back over your own SSH.

ssh_hosts.title: Allowed SSH host aliases
ssh_hosts.description: Comma-separated Host aliases from your ~/.ssh/config that the server tools may reach, for example myserver. Leave empty to keep the SSH tools off. Your own ssh-agent and known_hosts are used; never enter a key or password here.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional, read-only)
github_token.description: Only for reading Deploy to Plesk runs of a private repository: a fine-grained token with Actions: read and Metadata: read on that repository. Leave empty for public repositories.
